map.债务/欠款诉讼时效计算器: Statute of limitations calculator for debts and arrears
map.协议离婚或调解时，按双方约定的收入与比例快速估算抚养费，作为沟通参考。: For divorce by agreement or mediation, quickly estimate support from the income and ratio both sides agree on, as a reference for discussion.
map.填写「支付方月总收入（元）」。: Enter the payer's total monthly income (CNY).
map.填写「子女当前年龄」（用于估算剩余月数）。: Enter the child's current age (used to estimate remaining months).
map.填写「当地实际生活水平（元/月）」，作为保底下限。: Enter the local actual living standard (CNY/month) as the floor.
map.选择「支付比例」；选“自定义”时再填「自定义比例（%）」。: Select the payment ratio; if you choose "custom", also enter the custom ratio (%).
map.如需计入大额支出，勾选「有大额教育/医疗支出」并填写年度金额与分摊比例。: To include large expenses, tick "large education/medical expenses" and enter the annual amount and sharing ratio.
map.结果区会即时显示基础抚养费、每名子女金额、每月应支付与至 18 岁总额。: The result panel updates instantly with base support, per-child amount, monthly total and the total through age 18.
map.多子女时，对比不同总比例下每名子女的分摊金额。: With several children, compare the per-child share under different total ratios.
map.子女有大额教育/医疗支出时，把年度金额与分摊比例折算为月摊额。: When there are large education/medical expenses, convert the annual amount and sharing ratio into a monthly share.
map.本工具用的比例是法定标准吗？: Is the ratio used here a statutory standard?
map.不是。比例来自下拉选项或自定义输入，超过 50% 按 50% 计；工具只做算术估: No. The ratio comes from the dropdown or your custom input, and anything above 50% is capped at 50%. The tool only does arithmetic and does not embed any judicial-interpretation ratio table; the result is not legal advice.
map.生活水平保底怎么算？: How does the living-standard floor work?
map.基础抚养费取“月收入 × 比例”与“当地实际生活水平”两者的较大值；后者是你自己: Base support takes the larger of "monthly income × ratio" and "local actual living standard"; the latter is the floor you enter yourself, not a local standard looked up by the system.
map.大额教育/医疗支出怎么处理？: How are large education/medical expenses handled?
map.勾选后按“年度特殊支出 × 分摊比例 ÷ 12”折算为月摊额，加到每月应支付；未: Once ticked, they are converted with "annual special expenses × sharing ratio ÷ 12" and added to the monthly total; otherwise they are excluded.
map.按你输入的支付方月收入、支付比例与当地生活水平估算每月抚养费与至 18 岁总额；: Estimate monthly child support and the total through age 18 from the payer's monthly income, payment ratio and local living standard you enter; the ratio is capped at 50%, and education/medical expense sharing can be added. The tool only does arithmetic and is not legal advice.
map.输入支付方月收入、支付比例、当地实际生活水平、子女数量与年龄，工具按“收入 ×: Enter the payer's monthly income, payment ratio, local actual living standard, number of children and their age. The tool takes the larger of "income × ratio" and the living standard as base support, then splits it among the children; if large education/medical expenses are ticked, it converts the annual amount and sharing ratio into a monthly share and estimates the total through age 18.
map.本工具纯前端运行，输入内容不上传服务器；结果为按输入数值的算术估算，比例上限 5: This tool runs entirely in the front end and never uploads your input. Results are arithmetic estimates from your inputs: the ratio is capped at 50%, the living standard is a floor, and no judicial-interpretation ratio table is embedded—so this is not legal advice. The final amount is set by agreement between the parties or by a court ruling; for an actual dispute consult a licensed lawyer or a local legal-aid institution.
map.：基础抚养费 = max(15000 × 20%, 当地生活水平 2000) =: : base support = max(15000 × 20%, local living standard 2000) = 3,000 CNY/month; with one child the share stays 3,000 CNY/month. If the living standard is raised to 3,500, the 3,500 CNY floor applies.
map.：同一收入 1.5 万元、总比例 30% 时，基础抚养费 4500 元/月，每名: : on the same 15,000 CNY income at a 30% total ratio, base support = 4,500 CNY/month and each child gets 2,250 CNY/month; the total through age 18 = 4,500 × (18 − current age) × 12.
